sections.h2: Where to record a deed in Northumberland County
sections.html:
Deeds are recorded by the Register and Recorder at 201 Market Street, first floor, in Sunbury. The phone is 570-988-4143. On Mondays the office is open from 9:00 a.m. to 4:45 p.m., and Tuesday through Friday it runs 9:00 a.m. to 4:15 p.m. It closes every day from noon to 1:00 p.m., so a package that arrives at 12:15 p.m. waits until 1:00.

One office holds two jobs. It records land documents, and it also acts as register of wills for estates and issues marriage licenses. Heirs who sell an inherited house use both functions: first to open the estate, later to record the deed out of it. Probate visits are by appointment, booked at 570-988-4985.

Filing a deed costs $86.25 on the current schedule, whether it is taxable, nontaxable or a quit claim. That price assumes four pages, four names and a single tract.

Northumberland County recording charges
DocumentCharge
Deed of any kind$86.25
Mortgage$86.25
Satisfaction piece$64.75
Lease of 30 years or more$71.25
Right of way agreement$59.75
Affidavit affecting real estate$18.50
Statement of Value$2.00
UCC financing statement$100.00

Extras are small. Each page after the fourth adds $2.00, and each added name or added tract adds fifty cents (no tract charge on a mortgage). A marginal notation is $2.00.

A wrong fee gets the document rejected, and a payment that is too high counts as wrong. Add it up before writing the check.

sections.h2: How transfer tax is paid on a sale
sections.html:
A taxable deed owes the state's 1 percent, a local 1 percent and the recording fee. Separate checks are not required, so one check can cover all three amounts.

The grantor and grantee share liability for the state portion. The state also exempts some deeds, such as particular family transfers, deeds to a government body and inherited property.

An exempt deed still travels with a Statement of Value, priced at $2.00 here, and the title agent or attorney should state the reason for the exemption on the form.

sections.h2: What paperwork does the recorder require?
sections.html:
The county's requirements are short, so each item matters.

  • The document submitted must be an original.
  • If the recorded deed must come back by mail, enclose a stamped return envelope addressed to yourself.
  • No blanket assignments or satisfaction pieces.
  • The exact recording fee is required or the document is refused.

Electronic filing covers deeds, mortgages, assignments, satisfactions, mortgage releases, UCC filings and powers of attorney. Filers sign up with one of two vendors, CSC E-Recording Solutions or Simplifile.

An heir cannot sign a deed until someone has authority to act for the estate. In this county that authority comes from letters issued by the Register and Recorder, and the fee rises with the size of the estate.

  • Letters in an estate under $1,000 cost $142.75.
  • An estate between $50,001 and $100,000 costs $267.75.
  • Each additional $100,000, or fraction of it, adds $100.00.
  • Letters used for litigation only cost $102.75.

Those prices include the filing of the inventory and the inheritance tax return. The same office charges $50.00 for a certified copy of an instrument and $10.00 for a short certificate, which a title company may ask for. Call the office before the visit, since probate meetings run by appointment.

Heirs sometimes need smaller filings too, and the estate's representative usually learns about them only after the first visit. A disclaimer costs $15.00, a renunciation is $10.00 per name, a receipt and release in the register of wills is $10.00 per name, and a creditor's claim is $75.00. Whoever is handling the estate should add these to the budget before the house is listed.

Sunbury is the county seat and the biggest city, and Shamokin is the other city. The 2025 population estimate is 89,920. Housing costs are low: the latest five-year survey shows a $162,400 median home value, $60,583 in median household income and 75.5 percent owner occupancy. Every town in the county files with the Sunbury office.

Recording fees do not shrink with the price. An $86.25 deed fee is the same on a $90,000 house as on a $900,000 one, so on a low-priced sale it takes a bigger bite and belongs in the closing estimate as its own line.

sections.h2: Clearing an old mortgage at sale
sections.html:
The lender files a satisfaction piece or a release of mortgage with the recorder, and each costs $64.75 to record. A partial release costs the same. An assignment of a mortgage from one lender to another is $61.75.

The county refuses blanket satisfaction pieces, so each one has to name the specific mortgage it clears. If a paid-off mortgage still shows in the public record, ask the title company to track it down. Ask the lender how long it takes to file, so the record is clear for the buyer.

sections.h2: Step by step: getting the deed recorded
sections.html:
The order below keeps a sale from stalling at the counter. Sellers rarely handle this alone, since the closing agent usually files, but knowing the steps helps you ask the right questions.

  1. The title agent or attorney prepares the original deed and the Statement of Value. A taxable deed carries the state 1 percent and the local 1 percent, and an exempt deed carries the stated reason for the exemption.
  2. Someone totals the charges: $86.25 for the deed, $2.00 for the Statement of Value, plus any extra pages, names or tracts.
  3. The package goes in either by mail, with a stamped return envelope addressed to the filer, or through CSC E-Recording Solutions or Simplifile.
  4. The county records the deed and returns it.

If a mortgage is being paid off at the same closing, the lender's satisfaction piece is a separate filing at $64.75. Sellers who skip a lender payoff and sell for cash still need the deed filed, but they have fewer documents to track.

Work through this list before the deed leaves the title office.

  • Work out the exact fee from the schedule, including extra pages and names.
  • Bring a stamped, self-addressed return envelope.
  • Check the hours, including the noon closing.
  • Decide ahead whether the closing agent will file electronically through CSC or Simplifile.
  • For an inherited home, schedule the probate appointment well before the closing.

A cash sale does not remove any of these steps, since the deed is still recorded here. It does cut out lender requirements, so the paperwork is usually the deed, the Statement of Value and the fee.

faqs.q: What will a deed cost to file in Sunbury?
faqs.a: $86.25 for a deed of four pages, four names and one tract. Each extra page adds $2 and each extra name adds 50 cents.

faqs.q: Do I write one check or several for a taxable deed?
faqs.a: One check can cover the state tax, the local tax and the recording fee. Northumberland does not require separate checks.

faqs.q: Can a deed be recorded electronically?
faqs.a: Yes. CSC E-Recording Solutions and Simplifile handle electronic deeds, mortgages, assignments, satisfactions, releases, UCC filings and powers of attorney for the county.

faqs.q: When can I visit the Sunbury recorder?
faqs.a: The office opens at 9:00 a.m. It stays open until 4:45 p.m. on Mondays and 4:15 p.m. Tuesday through Friday, and it closes from noon to 1:00 p.m. every day.

faqs.q: What happens if I send the wrong fee?
faqs.a: The document comes back unrecorded, and a payment that is too high counts as wrong. Calculate the fee from the current schedule before mailing.
